about_the_game:
Virtuoso GP Race-On is a brand-new low-poly arcade racer engineered to feel like the hardware-pounding cabinets of 1993—no emulator, no ROMs, just custom physics locked at 30 fps and the classic “EXTEND TIME” pressure.

Drift through a cherry-blossom coastline, chase the clock, and discover why pace beats pixels every time.

PLAY THE FREE DEMO

  • 1 track – Sakura Coast

  • 1 car – formula-style flyer built for sideways bliss

  • Keyboard & game-pad support

  • Instant restart for speed-runners

KEY FEATURES ON FULL RELEASE

Arcade DNA
Cabinet-accurate handling – built from scratch, no Unity rigidbodies
Checkpoint rush – run out of time, it’s Game Over
Fixed 30 fps rhythm – just like 90's boards
9 circuits – 3 Routes (America, Eurasia and Afica&Oceania)

Modern Extras
Online leaderboards – chase world ghosts & lap splits
Rewind-free restart – fail fast, learn faster

WHY 30 FPS?

Those original cabinets were tuned around 30 frames, giving a distinct rhythm to inputs and speed cues. We’re embracing that DNA instead of chasing photorealism—because handling > polygons.

JOIN THE PIT CREW

Play the demo, smash a lap, and drop feedback in the community hub.

Wishlist now, then hit the demo button. See you at turn one!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2,0 GHz (Intel i3-2100 / AMD A6)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / GeForce GT 710 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3,0 GHz (Intel i5-4430 / Ryzen 3 1200)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 260X (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Not just a “retro look”: authentic ’90s handling with bespoke physics. Checkpoints + EXTEND TIME, instant restarts, ghosts and global leaderboards. Free demo.
